column1: # CAN THE 30 UNRESOLVED BODIES BE CLASSIFIED FROM THEIR SHAPE? NO. Measured, not argued.
# WHY THE QUESTION WAS WORTH ASKING. The CodeDomain vocabulary is 998 names in 53 families and
# the five largest families read like descriptions of a body's call and control shape -
# NativeRoutine.BoundedLoop.DirectCallOnly, NativeAdapter.BoundedDirectCall.Single.Linear,
# NativeDispatch.BoundedComputedCall.Acyclic.Branching, NativeInline.NoCall.*. If a domain is
# a mechanical description of a body, the 30 could be classified mechanically and L1's hard
# `unresolved = 0` gate would be cheap.
# POSITIVE CONTROL 1 - THE NAMES DO DESCRIBE THE BODIES. Over 6,000 already-classified bodies,
# each name token was scored against its plain reading of the body it is attached to:
#   Conditional 100.0%  Linear 100.0%  Acyclic 100.0%  Branching 100.0%  (n = 1149/1078/358/350)
#   BoundedLoop 99.9%   DirectCallOnly 99.9%  Single 99.9%              (n = 1381/1185/880)
#   NoCall 99.7%  - meaning no CALL instruction; an outward jmp is a tail call, counted as a
#                   TRANSFER but not as a call
#   Pair 90.1%    - NOT established, and never asserted anywhere in this work
# Single first scored 77.2% under every way of counting CALLS, which is how the tail-call rule
# was found: counting an outward jmp as a transfer took it to 1066/1067. The token was right
# and the reading was wrong.
# POSITIVE CONTROL 2 - THE DECODE IS SOUND. 1,066 of 1,067 sampled bodies decoded to 100% of
# their declared extent, so a missing transfer is not a missing decode. Any body under 95%
# coverage is excluded from the table below rather than guessed at.
# THE RESULT, AND IT IS NEGATIVE. The implication does not run backwards. A domain's name
# describes its body, but a body's shape does not pick its domain: the family carries semantic
# information - Phyre, ThirdParty, Boundary.Audio, EASTL - that control flow cannot supply.
# 28,129 classified bodies collapse into just 33 distinct shape signatures, so a signature is
# far too coarse to name one of 998 domains.
# For each of the 30: the signature its body actually has, how many classified bodies share
# that signature, and how pure that set is. PURITY RANGE 7.8% TO 75.0%, MEDIAN 21.0%. One
# member reaches 75% (002C3D70, NativeRoutine.BoundedLoop.DirectCallOnly) and 75% is not
# evidence - a disposition is not forced on it, because a forced disposition on the one
# member that scored best is exactly how a 30 -> 0 becomes dishonest.
# WHAT THIS LEAVES - CORRECTED 2026-09-16 (OPUS), SAME DAY, AND THE FIRST VERSION WAS WRONG.
# It read: "the only method with a track record is the one SWE2-FRONTIER used for the other 109:
# read the body ... that is what these 30 cost". THE READING IS ALREADY DONE. residual-30-GN161-
# stage1.tsv (OPUS, 2026-09-15, fb75d534) carries evidence validation and a PROPOSED DOMAIN for
# all 30: verdict `validated` on 30 of 30, 30 distinct domains, zero colliding with the 998
# already in the graph, from passages that already exist in the corpus. check_residual_depth at
# HEAD bands all 30 DESCRIBED, CONTESTED 0, NEEDS-THE-BODY-READ 0.
# WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS is not documentation: batch application into the certified GN161 parent,
# a pre/post FAS2 fence and fresh-import certification (SWE2-EC7), then INDEPENDENT re-certification
# (SWE2-AUDIT-SEM). OPUS proposed these domains and must not certify them.
# THE MEASUREMENT BELOW IS UNAFFECTED and still worth having: shape does not determine domain,
# so no mechanical shortcut exists. It simply does not follow that reading is what remains.
